meanings.def: to express complaints, discontent, displeasure, or unhappiness
meanings.example: The students quetched about their math class during lunch.
meanings.example_tl: Ang mga mag -aaral ay nag -quetch tungkol sa kanilang klase sa matematika sa tanghalian.

meanings.def: to give up in the face of defeat of lacking hope
meanings.example: The team was down a player but would not quit.
meanings.example_tl: Ang koponan ay bumaba ng isang manlalaro ngunit hindi huminto.

meanings.def: to go away or leave
meanings.example: I quit the bar at around one in the morning.
meanings.example_tl: Tumigil ako sa bar bandang isa sa umaga.

meanings.def: to turn away from
meanings.example: They quit each other after a long argument.
meanings.example_tl: Tumigil sila sa isa't isa pagkatapos ng mahabang pagtatalo.

meanings.def: to give up or retire from a position
meanings.example: I quit my board seat after ten years of service.
meanings.example_tl: Tumigil ako sa aking board seat pagkatapos ng sampung taong serbisyo.

meanings.def: to put an end to a state or an activity
meanings.example: I quit smoking three years ago.
meanings.example_tl: Tumigil ako sa paninigarilyo tatlong taon na ang nakalilipas.

meanings.def: to become quiet or quieter
meanings.example: The raucous crowd quiesced as the orator slowly won them over.

meanings.def: to put down by force or intimidation
meanings.example: The government quashes any attempt of an uprising.
meanings.example_tl: Ang gobyerno ay huminto sa anumang pagtatangka ng isang pag -aalsa.

meanings.def: to declare invalid
meanings.example: The motion was quashed during the meeting.
meanings.example_tl: Ang paggalaw ay tinanggal sa panahon ng pagpupulong.
